text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, excuse me, you two. Do you have a 
moment? It's regarding the plans for that 
birthday party.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! That's super-duper stylish☆ I'm gonna 
do it too~☆ And then peace-peace~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If you're in, count me in too~♪ Man, 
taking purikura photos sounds like so much 
fun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Celebrating our growth side by side 
with friends... And if it's being filmed 
with "cool" gear, I can't help but look 
forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I even studied how to do "doodling"! 
However, no matter how many times I try, I 
struggle to draw a neat heart without 
squishing it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, that subtle part just doesn't look 
right. Hey Teach, do you have any good 
tips or something~?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it~♪ It's just adding to the 
vibe☆ It's to-to-totally fine-desu♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I see, it's about going with the vibe... 
In other words, you won't know until the 
moment actually arrives...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu♪ Now I'm looking forward to it even 
more.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whoa, the vibes are super hot~~☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well then, we gotta hype things up too~♪ 
Which means—
